interface.signature: def minStepToReachTarget(KnightPos: list[int], TargetPos: list[int], N: int) -> int:

preconditions.expression: len(KnightPos) == 2 and len(TargetPos) == 2 and 1 <= N <= 1000 and all(1 <= x <= N for x in KnightPos + TargetPos)
preconditions.description: KnightPos and TargetPos are 1-based coordinates of length 2 within the N×N chessboard bounds (1 ≤ N ≤ 1000).

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or (return_value >= 0 and all(0 <= x < N for x in KnightPos) and all(0 <= y < N for y in TargetPos))
postconditions.description: If no path exists, return -1. Otherwise, return the minimum steps (non-negative integer) required for the knight to move from KnightPos to TargetPos on an N×N board (0-based internally).
If the knight is already at the target, return 0 steps.

postconditions.expression: any(return_value == steps and all(0 <= x < N and 0 <= y < N for x, y in path) for steps in range(0, N*N) for path in [[KnightPos]] if any(all((abs(x1-x2), abs(y1-y2)) in [(1,2), (2,1)] for x1,y1 in [path[-1]] for x2,y2 in [(x,y)]) and path + [(x,y)] not in [path] for x,y in [(x,y)]) for _ in range(steps)) and path[-1] == TargetPos)
postconditions.description: The returned steps are the minimum possible for a valid path where each move is a knight's L-shape (Δx,Δy) ∈ {(±1,±2), (±2,±1)}, and all intermediate positions are within the N×N board (0-based).
